# Thirza Abernethy

[Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society)

## Overview

- **Age:** fifty years of age  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P41](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** alive (since v2)  <sub>[v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008)</sub>
- **Family:** [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) (child), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) (sibling), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) (relative), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Thirza possesses a tall, slender, and lean frame defined by sharp angles, with lined cheeks and rough, labor-calloused hands. Her dark hair, increasingly silvered with graying strands, is kept constantly bound at the back in a tight, firm bun. Though she previously faced the prospect of total blindness due to failing eyesight, her eyes have since improved significantly; while unlikely to ever improve further, they are stable and no longer at risk of complete failure.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P24](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0024), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), +1 more_

## Personality

Thirza Abernethy is a practical, rational, and composed individual who maintains a calm demeanor, though she can also display a stern, strict, and fault-finding side. Characterized by an unyielding sense of morality, she operates under an uncompromising commitment to duty and is fond of attaching moral lessons to her words, while strictly refusing on principle to express opinions about ministers. Though she lacks a refined appreciation of beauty and can occasionally be pessimistic, she possesses a pleasant, good-humored side and a nascent sense of humor, even as she has turned somewhat mellow. While her disposition makes her reserved in expressing affection and prone to anxiety over Nell's emotional nature, she is well-regarded for her practical talents. Her notable skills include crafting rugs, making yellow plum preserves, and producing famous homemade currant wine.

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for sixty years and had never gone out on the local pond [F6, F7]. In her youth, she was close friends with John Carrow, who was considered her beau, and she inherited an amethyst brooch from her mother [F1, F2]. Later in life, after her brother [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) mistakenly picked up an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) instead of expected boy, Thirza initially insisted that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) be returned to the asylum [S4]. However, after refusing to leave [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md), Thirza agreed to keep her and took responsibility for her religious upbringing and education [S7, S8]. Though she often scolded [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for her dramatic nature, Thirza gradually grew fond of her and felt remorse when she falsely accused the girl of stealing her amethyst brooch [S14, S16, S17]. Following Obed's sudden death from a bank failure, Thirza faced severe vision failure and considered selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gave up her college scholarship to stay home and care for her [S49, S50, S51]. Later, Thirza was persuaded to take in the orphaned Farrow twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), who came to live permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) [S61, S62, S77]. Eventually, Thirza proposed inviting the newly widowed [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could finally resign her teaching job and attend college [S83].

## Quotes

> "At minimum, provide me with someone native born. A risk will exist, regardless of whom we obtain. Nevertheless, my mind will be more at ease and my night’s sleep will be sounder if we obtain a born Canadian."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)

> "No. A boy is what we need to assist Obed on the farm. To us, a girl would be useless. Remove your hat. On the hall table, I’ll place it along with your bag."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)

> "Now, strip off your clothes as fast as possible and get into bed. In a little while, I’ll return to fetch the candle. Leaving you to extinguish it on your own is too risky. It’s probable you’d burn down the house."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0044)

> "Obed Abernethy, my belief is that you have been enchanted by that child! It is as clear as day to me that your desire is to retain her."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061)

> "Obed Abernethy, my surprise at you is great. Though aware of Nell’s terrible conduct, you still defend her! Next, I expect you will claim that no punishment whatsoever should be given to her!"
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) is a longstanding neighbor and friend of Thirza, who also acts as a traveling companion on boat trips into town. [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) frequently visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to offer advice, express doubts over farm decisions, or voice strong warnings. Although tensions flared when [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) insulted Nell's appearance, Thirza maintained their connection by ensuring [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) formally apologized to restore peace.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thirza-abernethy.md)

Thirza acts as a guardian, mentor, and maternal figure to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), providing structure, instruction, and religious upbringing. Though initially intent on sending [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back when she arrived instead of an expected orphan boy, Thirza grew fond of the girl and chose to keep her at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Over time, their dynamic evolved into a deep mutual affection, with Thirza directing Nell's daily discipline while offering motherly care.

### [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/obed-abernethy--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) is Thirza's brother, with whom she lives at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and together raised [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). They collaborate on household and farm matters, discussing decisions such as adopting an orphan and providing proper religious guidance. While Thirza initially proved more firm and decisive regarding farm affairs and Nell's placement, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) offered a gentler, quieter perspective.

### [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/thirza-abernethy--tranter.md)

Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) is an acquaintance whom Thirza consults regarding orphan placement. Thirza traveled to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet with Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) in order to arrange Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) before ultimately deciding to keep the girl. In later years, Thirza continues to share local updates and news with her.

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/robin-farrow--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) is Thirza's third cousin once removed, whom she brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) as his guardian following the death of his parents. Thirza constantly manages his energetic misbehavior and pranks, enforcing strict discipline such as sending him to bed without dinner. Despite his frequent mischief and lying, Thirza actively works to forgive him and guide his moral upbringing.
